results.name: Machine Lateral Raise
instructions: Sit on the lateral raise machine with your feet flat on the floor and your back pressed firmly against the backrest. Adjust the seat height so that the pads rest against the outside of your upper arms.
Grasp the handles with both hands, keeping your elbows bent.
Raise your arms out to the sides until they are parallel to the floor and slowly lower your arms back to the starting position with control.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
tips: Exhale as you raise your arms and inhale as you lower them back down.
Use a moderate weight to ensure proper form and gradually increase the resistance as you get stronger.
Focus on engaging your shoulder muscles throughout the movement.
results.description: Machine Lateral Raise is a beginner single-joint isolation pushing exercise targeting the delts (shoulders). Performed with a leverage machine, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Upper Back.

results.name: Plate Car Driver
instructions: Stand holding a weight plate at the 3 and 9 o'clock positions, arms extended at shoulder height.
Turn the plate to one side as if steering a car.
Return to the centre and turn it to the other side.
Keep alternating while your arms stay at shoulder height.
tips: Keep your arms straight and level.
Keep your torso still.
results.description: Plate Car Driver is an intermediate single-joint isolation pushing exercise targeting the delts (shoulders). Performed with a weighted, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Forearms, Core.

results.name: Plate Full Front Raise
instructions: Stand holding a weight plate at the sides, arms extended in front of your thighs.
Raise the plate in front of you with straight arms.
Continue up until it is overhead.
Lower slowly to your thighs and repeat.
tips: Brace your core so you don't lean back.
Use a light plate for the full range.
results.description: Plate Full Front Raise is an intermediate single-joint isolation pushing exercise targeting the delts (shoulders). Performed with a weighted, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Upper Chest, Traps.

results.name: Plate Halo
instructions: Hold a weight plate by its sides in front of your chest.
Move the plate around your head in a circle, close to your head.
Bring it back to the front.
Repeat in one direction, then switch direction.
tips: Keep your core braced and hips still.
Keep the plate close to your head.
results.description: Plate Halo is an intermediate single-joint isolation pushing exercise targeting the delts (shoulders). Performed with a weighted, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Triceps, Upper Back, Core.

results.name: Plate Internally Rotated Rear Delt Fly
instructions: Hinge forward with a flat back, holding a light plate in each hand, thumbs turned in.
Let your arms hang below your shoulders.
Raise your arms out to the sides, leading with your elbows.
Lower slowly and repeat.
tips: Use light plates.
Squeeze your rear shoulders at the top.
results.description: Plate Internally Rotated Rear Delt Fly is an intermediate single-joint isolation pulling exercise targeting the delts (shoulders). Performed with a weighted, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Upper Back, Traps.

results.name: Plate Lateral Raise
instructions: Stand holding a light weight plate in each hand at your sides.
Keep a slight bend in your elbows.
Raise your arms out to the sides until they reach shoulder height.
Lower slowly and repeat.
tips: Lead with your elbows.
Don't shrug your shoulders.
results.description: Plate Lateral Raise is an intermediate single-joint isolation pushing exercise targeting the delts (shoulders). Performed with a weighted, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Traps.

results.name: Plate Overhead Press to Tricep Extension
instructions: Hold a weight plate at your chest and press it overhead.
With your upper arms by your ears, lower the plate behind your head by bending your elbows.
Extend your elbows to bring the plate back overhead.
Lower the plate to your chest and repeat.
tips: Keep your elbows pointing forward during the extension.
Brace your core.
results.description: Plate Overhead Press to Tricep Extension is an intermediate single-joint isolation pushing exercise targeting the delts (shoulders). Performed with a weighted, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Core.

results.name: Plate Overhead Shrug
instructions: Press a weight plate overhead with your arms locked out.
Shrug your shoulders up toward your ears, pushing the plate higher.
Hold briefly.
Lower your shoulders with control and repeat.
tips: Keep your arms locked.
Good for overhead stability.
results.description: Plate Overhead Shrug is an intermediate single-joint isolation pulling exercise targeting the traps (back). Performed with a weighted, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Shoulders, Serratus Anterior.

results.name: Plate Reach
instructions: Stand holding a weight plate at your chest.
Press the plate straight out in front of you.
Hold it briefly at arm's length.
Bring it back to your chest and repeat.
tips: Keep your core braced.
Don't let your shoulders shrug.
results.description: Plate Reach is an intermediate single-joint isolation pushing exercise targeting the delts (shoulders). Performed with a weighted, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Core, Chest.

results.name: Plate Rear Delt Fly
instructions: Hinge forward with a flat back, holding a light plate in each hand.
Let your arms hang below your shoulders with a slight bend in your elbows.
Raise your arms out to the sides until they are level with your shoulders.
Lower slowly and repeat.
tips: Keep your neck in line with your spine.
Use a light weight.
results.description: Plate Rear Delt Fly is an intermediate single-joint isolation pulling exercise targeting the delts (shoulders). Performed with a weighted, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Upper Back, Traps.
